french: Vous avez eu une grande discussion avec Seridia, et ensemble, vous avez pris la décision de fonder une famille !
russian: Вы отлично поговорили с Серидией. Вы оба решили, что пора завести семью!
bulgarian: You had a great conversation with Seridia. You both decided it's time to start a family!

english: But of course.
french: Oui, bien évidemment.
bulgarian: But of course.

english: We have all the time in the world. There is no real hurry.
french: Nous avons tout notre temps. Rien ne presse.
russian: У нас впереди целая вечность. Спешить и правда некуда.
bulgarian: We have all the time in the world. There is no real hurry.

english: If you find yourself reconsidering, let us speak again.
french: Mais si jamais tu changeais d'avis, reparlons-en.
bulgarian: If you find yourself reconsidering, let us speak again.

english: So I will come right out and say it.
french: Je vais donc éviter les digressions et tout te dire.
bulgarian: So I will come right out and say it.

english: What are your thoughts about... procreation?
french: Que penses-tu de la... procréation ?
russian: Что ты думаешь о... продолжении рода?
bulgarian: What are your thoughts about... procreation?

english: Having a baby? I would love to!
french: Tu veux qu'on ait un enfant ? J'adorerais !
bulgarian: Having a baby? I would love to!

english: I'm not sure if I'm ready...
french: Je ne sais pas si c'est le bon moment.
bulgarian: I'm not sure if I'm ready...

english: Ah, excellent!
french: Parfait !
bulgarian: Ah, excellent!

english: That makes two of us, then!
french: Alors, nous sommes deux !
bulgarian: That makes two of us, then!

english: I have become content with you by my side, but lately I have found myself wondering what a child born of us would be like.
french: T'avoir à mes côtés me satisfait toujours autant, mais dernièrement, j'ai commencé à me demander à quoi ressemblerait un enfant né de notre union.
russian: Я обрела покой, когда ты рядом, но в последнее время всё чаще задумываюсь, каким было бы дитя, рождённое от нас.
bulgarian: I have become content with you by my side, but lately I have found myself wondering what a child born of us would be like.

english: Powerfully magical, half-dragon, the best parts of both of us.
french: Dragon pour moitié, grand ou grande mage pour l'autre, ce que nous faisons de mieux.
russian: Наделённое великой магией, наполовину дракон, вобравшее лучшее от нас обоих.
bulgarian: Powerfully magical, half-dragon, the best parts of both of us.

english: Also I suspect that they would be... extremely adorable.
french: Et j'imagine que notre progéniture serait... extrêmement adorable.
russian: А ещё, подозреваю, оно было бы... невероятно очаровательным.
bulgarian: Also I suspect that they would be... extremely adorable.

english: I'm ready for a baby, if you are!
french: Si tu te sens d'avoir un enfant, moi aussi !
bulgarian: I'm ready for a baby, if you are!

english: We'd better think about it more first.
french: Nous devrions y réfléchir encore un peu.
bulgarian: We'd better think about it more first.

english: Oh... [Ari].
french: Oh, [Ari]...
bulgarian: Oh... [Ari].

english: Beloved, I have a matter that I wish to discuss with you.
french: Mon amour, j'aimerais que nous ayons une discussion.
russian: Любовь моя, у меня есть дело, которое я хочу с тобой обсудить.
bulgarian: Beloved, I have a matter that I wish to discuss with you.

english: I... well. There is something I've been meaning to ask you.
french: Je, euh... Je voulais que nous discutions de quelque chose.
russian: Я... что ж. Есть кое-что, о чём я давно хотел тебя спросить.
bulgarian: I... well. There is something I've been meaning to ask you.

english: If... if you're sure...
french: Si... Si tu en as envie aussi...
russian: Если... если ты точно этого хочешь...
bulgarian: If... if you're sure...

english: Yes! Let's start a family!
french: Alors, oui ! Fondons une famille !
bulgarian: Yes! Let's start a family!

english: You had a great conversation with Valen. You both decided it's time to start a family!
french: Vous avez eu une grande discussion avec Valen, et ensemble, vous avez pris la décision de fonder une famille !
russian: Вы отлично поговорили с Вален. Вы решили, что пора завести семью!
bulgarian: You had a great conversation with Valen. You both decided it's time to start a family!

english: I understand.
french: Je comprends.
bulgarian: I understand.

english: There's no rush. It's a major decision.
french: Rien ne presse. Ce n'est pas une décision à prendre à la légère.
bulgarian: There's no rush. It's a major decision.

english: When... if you want to talk about it again, just let me know.
french: Mais si un jour tu veux qu'on en reparle, ce sera avec plaisir.
russian: Когда... если захочешь ещё раз об этом поговорить, просто дай знать.
bulgarian: When... if you want to talk about it again, just let me know.

english: Something that, as a couple, I feel we should at least discuss...
french: C'est un sujet qu'en tant que couple, nous devons aborder selon moi
russian: Кое-что, что нам как паре, я считаю, стоило бы хотя бы обсудить...
bulgarian: Something that, as a couple, I feel we should at least discuss...

english: What are your thoughts on... starting a family?
french: Que tu dirais de... fonder une famille ?
russian: Что ты думаешь о том, чтобы... завести семью?
bulgarian: What are your thoughts on... starting a family?

english: I would love to!
french: Ce serait merveilleux !
bulgarian: I would love to!

english: I'm not sure if I'm ready...
french: Je ne sais pas si c'est le bon moment.
bulgarian: I'm not sure if I'm ready...

english: Oh!
french: Oh !
bulgarian: Oh!

english: I'm glad you're so taken with the idea.
french: Je suis ravie que cette idée t'enthousiasme.
russian: Я рад, что эта мысль тебя так увлекла.
bulgarian: I'm glad you're so taken with the idea.

english: To be honest with you, I never used to picture myself raising a child.
french: Pour être tout à fait honnête, je ne me suis jamais imaginée élever un enfant.
russian: Честно говоря, раньше я и представить не мог себя с ребёнком.
bulgarian: To be honest with you, I never used to picture myself raising a child.

english: But since we got married, I find myself warming to the thought of having a family of our own.
french: Mais depuis notre mariage, l'idée de fonder une famille avec toi ne fait que grandir.
russian: Но с тех пор, как мы поженились, мысль о собственной семье всё больше мне по душе.
bulgarian: But since we got married, I find myself warming to the thought of having a family of our own.

english: And I... I truly believe that we would make good parents.
french: Et je... je crois sincèrement que nous ferions de très bons parents.
russian: И я... я искренне верю, что из нас вышли бы хорошие родители.
bulgarian: And I... I truly believe that we would make good parents.

english: I'm ready to start a family, if you are!
french: Si tu veux fonder une famille, je te suis !
bulgarian: I'm ready to start a family, if you are!

english: We'd better think about it more first.
french: Nous devrions y réfléchir encore un peu.
bulgarian: We'd better think about it more first.

english: [Ari], I...
french: Écoute, [Ari], je...
bulgarian: [Ari], I...

english: [Ari], do you have a few minutes to talk?
french: Peux-tu m'accorder quelques minutes, [Ari] ?
bulgarian: [Ari], do you have a few minutes to talk?
